features.feature_value: Insults/insulting language were the main factor that would cause removal.
features.evidence_span: "If either one used insults or things of the like."
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states that using insults (in either version) is the decision trigger.

features.feature_value: They drew the line at name-calling, swearing, or inciting violence.
features.evidence_span: "I drew the line at name-calling, swearing, or inciting violence."
features.rationale: This describes specific content boundaries used in their judgment.

features.feature_value: They focused on physical-violence threats; none were present, so most were allowed.
features.evidence_span: "There were no direct threats of physical violence."
features.rationale: The participant conditions their flag/keep decisions on whether physical-violence threats appear.

features.feature_value: They evaluated whether statements were harmful to a group of people.
features.evidence_span: "if anything stated was harmful to a group of people."
features.rationale: They describe a specific harm-to-group criterion guiding their response.

features.feature_value: Generally allowed viewpoints under free speech, but denied when comments were too degrading.
features.evidence_span: "I was focused on free speech mostly... Only when a comment felt too degrading did I decide to deny it.;"
features.rationale: They articulate a general free-speech approach with an exception for degrading tone.

features.feature_value: Evaluated the entire message and allowed civil sentences that didn’t generalize people/groups.
features.evidence_span: "I tried to evaluate the entirety of the message instead of focusing on one sentence"
features.rationale: They highlight a process of integrating across the full message, plus a criterion about generalization.

features.evidence_span: "Sensationalist language, although a few were borderline."
features.rationale: They mention sensationalism as a cue affecting their judgments, especially near the cutoff.

features.feature_value: They looked out for posts that aren’t constructive and have a tone that dissuades real conversation, even while trying to be open-minded.
features.evidence_span: "keep an open mind mainly look out for posts that aren't constructive... tone that dissuades actual conversations."
features.rationale: This combines an open-minded stance with a concrete tone/constructiveness criterion.
